overview: The committee heard presentations for the second round of Community Preservation Act funding applications, including park renovations, historic estate restorations, and new recreational amenities.

items.title: Harris Park Phase 2 Design Funding
items.summary: The Office of Community Development requested funding for the design of a softball field, rain garden, and accessibility improvements at the 2.5-acre park.

items.title: Brooks Estate Trail Restoration
items.summary: Tom Lincoln presented a plan to restore 1,300 linear feet of walking trails using wood chips and install an informational kiosk; the committee discussed ADA compliance for natural trail surfaces.

items.title: Brooks Estate Stone Wall Restoration
items.summary: The applicant proposed a $45,000 phase-one request to restore 300 linear feet of a historic 19th-century stone wall along Grove Street.

items.title: Brooks Estate Manor Wood Trim Restoration
items.summary: The committee reviewed a request for $45,000 to scrape, paint, and repair the third-floor exterior wood trim and dormers of the historic manor building.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Bocce Courts
items.summary: The Mayor's Office and Housing Authority proposed installing two bocce courts behind the Senior Center to provide outdoor recreation for residents and local leagues.

items.title: Wrights Pond Beautification
items.summary: Friends of Wrights Pond requested $4,845 for new plantings and invasive species removal surrounding the park's bandstand.

items.title: Gillis Park and Medford Little League Improvements
items.summary: Medford Little League presented a request for fence and wall repairs alongside an ADA accessibility study for the ball field at Gillis Park.
